instruction.text: A car travels at a constant speed of 60 miles per hour. How far does the car travel in 1.5 hours?
A recipe for 4 servings of soup requires 6 cups of water. How many cups of water are needed for 6 servings?
If a bicycle wheel rotates 400 times in one minute, how many times does it rotate in 15 seconds?
A printer prints 120 pages in 4 minutes. How many pages can it print in 10 minutes at the same rate?
A container holds 8 litres of juice. If each glass can hold 250 millilitres of juice, how many glasses can be filled from the container?
A school cafeteria serves 250 pupils in 5 days, serving an equal number of pupils each day. How many pupils are served in 2 days?
A gardener plants 84 flowers in rows of equal amounts. If there are 7 rows in total, how many flowers are in 3 rows?
If a factory produces 480 widgets in 8 hours, how many widgets does it produce in 3 hours?
